acceptance_criteria.criterion: Super-admin /ops/zoho sayfasina girince tum tenant'larin Zoho baglanti durumu listelenir (tenant_id + region + connected badge + connected_at + last_refreshed_at + zoho_user_email). Backend GET /api/ops/zoho/connections -> Integrations GET /api/internal/ops/zoho/connections. ValidateOpsAuth yok ise 401.

Cross-tenant sync log filter (tenant_id + status + zoho_event + from/to + page/pageSize, pageSize max 100) + pagination calisir. Backend GET /api/ops/zoho/sync-log -> Integrations GET /api/internal/ops/zoho/sync-log. Response: items[] + page + pageSize + totalCount. Items'ta tenant_id kolonu mevcut.

Force-disconnect: Backend DELETE /api/ops/zoho/connections/{tenantId} -> Integrations DELETE /api/internal/ops/zoho/connections/{tenantId}. Integrations tarafi ZohoTokenProvider.RevokeRefreshTokenAsync best-effort + ZohoConnectionRepository.DisconnectAsync(tenantId) (mevcut metotlar). Backend JsonLinesLogger SystemInfo: super_admin=<username> action=disconnect target_tenant=<id>. Active connection yoksa 404.

Force-retry (batch): Backend POST /api/ops/zoho/sync-log/retry body {ids:[long], ...max 50} -> Integrations POST /api/internal/ops/zoho/sync-log/retry. Integrations: her id icin ZohoSyncLogRepository.ResetForRetryAsync (tenant_id de row'dan cozulur, cross-tenant) — failed olmayan veya bulunmayan id'ler skipped[]. Response: {requested, updated, skipped:[{id,reason}]}. Backend audit SystemInfo. ids.Count > 50 ise 400 (INV-INT-134). ids bos ise 400.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Backend /api/ops/zoho/* -> Integrations /api/internal/ops/zoho/* uzerinden shared-secret X-Internal-Service-Token (JWT forward DEGIL).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Super-admin JWT'si Integrations /api/v1/ JwtAuth middleware'i icin gecersiz (tenant_id iceri tasinmiyor; TenantContext yok). Cross-tenant ops ayri bir trust boundary — mevcut InternalServices:SharedSecret (P1/P2/P3-B1'de kurulu) yeniden kullanilir, ayri bir secret veya yeni auth katmani acilmaz. Cross-tenant action'larin tum audit sorumlulugu Backend tarafinda (ValidateOpsAuth + JsonLinesLogger SystemInfo).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Codex 'Neden JWT forward degil?' diye sorarsa: super-admin JWT -> Integrations /api/v1/ -> TenantContext null -> 401. Mevcut JwtAuth middleware cross-tenant ops icin tasarlanmadi. Shared-secret model tek trust boundary, tum audit Backend'de. P3-B1 JWT forward pattern user-facing tenant ops icin gecerliydi (Integrations kendi tenant_id'sini JWT'den cikarabiliyordu); burada tenant_id path/body'den geliyor, Integrations kendi authenticate ediyor.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Batch retry max 50 + per-id skip reporting (whole-batch 400 DEGIL).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: UI multi-select; kullanicinin sectigi 50 id'den bazilari arka planda state degistirmis olabilir (worker basarili olmus vs). Whole-batch reject UX'i bozar; skip + rapor UX secenegi Q onayli.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Codex 'Batch partial success idempotency riski' diyebilir. Kabul: response skipped[] acik reason dokuman eder, UI banner gosterir. Row bazinda already-pending state de skip olarak donulur.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Audit log SADECE Backend tarafinda (JsonLinesLogger SystemInfo) — Integrations'a ayri audit log/tablo eklenmez.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Backend /api/ops/* tum super-admin aksiyonunun giris kapisi; Basic Auth username veya JWT role:admin buradan cozulur. Integrations audit'in kaynagini (kim) bilmiyor (shared-secret internal caller). Cift audit kayit redundancy; kaynagi tutan Backend yeterli.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Codex 'Integrations tarafi audit yok' diyebilir. Kabul: Q interview'de karar verildi (audit yalniz Backend). Integrations arka uc action log'u zaten JsonLinesLogger ile tutuyor (disconnect/retry action success/failure).

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Force-disconnect endpoint path /api/ops/zoho/connections/{tenantId} — tenantId URL'de; Integrations tarafi path'ten okur.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: RESTful convention; query/body'ye karistirilmaz. Integrations'ta TenantContext (JWT) yok, tenant_id path parametresi. Shared-secret caller trust boundary.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: Codex 'tenant_id path vs body' tutarsizlik diyebilir. Kabul: /api/internal/* shared-secret modelinde path parametresi standart — P1 POST /api/internal/zoho/sync body.TenantId vs burada DELETE path tenantId — DELETE ile body kullanmak HTTP semantigine uymaz.

verification_questions.question: Ops endpoints tum super-admin auth kontrolunu ValidateOpsAuth uzerinden yapiyor mu, herhangi bir bypass path var mi?
Cross-tenant sync log/connection sorgulari tenant_id filtrelemesinden bagimsiz olarak calisiyor, ancak her row'da tenant_id geri donuyor mu?
Batch retry max 50 sinirlamasi + skip reporting dogru sekilde donuyor mu; invalid payload (>50 veya empty) 400 mu?
Force-disconnect + batch-retry action'lari Backend tarafinda JsonLinesLogger SystemInfo ile (super_admin + tenant_id + action) audit yaziyor mu?
Integrations /api/internal/ops/zoho/* endpoints shared-secret (X-Internal-Service-Token) ile koruma altinda mi; kayip/yanlis token icin 401/403 mu?
